استقيأت (form X)

# اِسْتَقْيَأْتَ (istaqyaʔta) /is.taq.jaʔ.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِسْتَقْيَأَ (istaqyaʔa)
# اِسْتَقْيَأْتِ (istaqyaʔti) /is.taq.jaʔ.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِسْتَقْيَأَ (istaqyaʔa)
# اِسْتَقْيَأَتْ (istaqyaʔat) /is.t
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
